description: This file defines a Java interface ResultGetter<T> with a generic method get() for retrieving a result of type T. It serves as a contract for classes that implement custom retrieval logic within the persistence utility package of the 'thingsearch' service.

classes.name: ResultGetter
classes.description: A generic interface defining a contract for getter methods that return a value of type T.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the result of type T. Implementing classes define the actual retrieval logic.
